title: Low serum iron with key discriminating studies withheld

patient_context.chief_complaint: Interpret a low serum iron result in a patient with anemia.
patient_context.history: The simulated case includes chronic inflammatory disease. Ferritin, TIBC and transferrin saturation are intentionally withheld.

interaction.prompt: Decide whether the low serum iron is sufficient to diagnose iron deficiency. Identify which missing measurements would materially improve discrimination.

must_include: State that low serum iron alone is not specific for iron deficiency.
Keep anemia of inflammation in the differential because the source says low serum iron can occur there too.
Identify ferritin plus iron-binding/transferrin-saturation context as important missing discriminators.
must_not_claim: Do not diagnose iron deficiency solely from the serum iron value.
Do not claim the inflammatory context proves anemia of inflammation either.
acceptable_actions: Return INSUFFICIENT_FOR_BINARY_DIAGNOSIS and specify missing discriminating evidence.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: High uncertainty is required because the intentionally withheld studies contain the discriminative signal.

forbidden_claims: low serum iron confirms iron deficiency
chronic inflammation confirms anemia of inflammation

critical_errors: Diagnoses iron deficiency solely from low serum iron.
Fails to note that the key discriminating studies are missing.
